title: Good, but weak lid.
text: Good, but weak lid.. Works wonderfully in our CR-V between a booster seat and a toddler's car seat. Our daughters store coloring activities, snacks, winter wear, and toys. The lid is pretty flimsy and doesn't stay put. I think it should be rigid, maybe incorporating plastic into the structure.

product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do Backseat Center Organizer AUT-07981 Grey
features: Customizable storage options creates 1, 2 or 3 interior compartments
Offers 6 pockets for versatile storage and two handles for carrying
Removable lid serves as catch-all for loose items
Made with durable recycled fabric that wipes clean easily
Crisply folds flat when not in use
Versatile color goes with any interior
description: Your back seat houses the rowdy members of the family and it’s starting to resemble their rooms: complete with empty water bottles, candy wrappers, headphones and the occasional sock (yep, just one). This Back Seat Counsel Organizer should do the trick. Complete with six pockets to keep their gear all in one place, it also provides customizable storage options and a removable lid where they can keep just what they need. With fabric that cleans easily and the ability to fold it flat when you’re flying solo, this car caddy is the ultimate kids organizer for the road.
